title: Little dragon eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M62 34 L66 20 L56 30 Z' fill='#f1c40f'/>

  <path d='M30 56 L26 50 L34 54 Z' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <path d='M24 64 L18 60 L25 62 Z' fill='#f1c40f'/>

  <path d='M56 66 Q60 62 62 62' stroke='#27ae60' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M44 57 Q46 60 48 57' stroke='#1a7a44' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
